name: Views Color Scales
description: Automatically enhances ALL Views numeric fields with optional Excel-style color scaling.
project_description:
This module is part of the DXPR ecosystem and included in DXPR CMS .

 Views Color Scales automatically adds Excel-style color gradients to numeric fields in Views. Transform boring numbers into visual insights - sentiment scores, performance metrics, and ratings instantly become color-coded for at-a-glance understanding.

 
 You need Views Color Scales if 
 
 You display numeric data in Views and want instant visual insights 
 You need to quickly identify patterns in performance metrics, ratings, or scores 
 You want Excel-style heat maps for your Drupal data without complex configuration 
 You manage dashboards with sentiment analysis, survey results, or financial data 
 You prefer visual data representation over scanning columns of numbers 
 
 Features 
 What solution does this module provide? 

 Views Color Scales solves the problem of quickly understanding numeric data patterns in Drupal Views. Instead of scanning columns of numbers, users instantly see performance through color gradients - red for low values, green for high values, with smooth transitions in between.

 Basic functionality: 

 
 Automatically enhances ALL numeric fields in any View - no duplicate fields needed 
 One-click enable/disable per field - use it only where you need it 
 Configurable color schemes - choose your own min/max colors for each field 
 Smart auto-detection - automatically finds the data range or set manual limits 
 Accessible design - automatic black/white text for optimal contrast 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Getting started is simple: 

 
 Enable the module - No initial configuration needed 
 Edit any View containing numeric data (Structure > Views > Edit) 
 Click on any numeric field to configure it 
 Look for "Color Scale" options in the field settings (appears automatically) 
 Check "Enable Color Scale" to activate the feature 
 Save and see results - Your numbers now have color gradients! 
 
 Configuration options per field: 

 
 Enable Color Scale - Turn on/off per field 
 Auto-detect min/max - Let the module find your data range (recommended) 
 Manual min/max values - Set specific thresholds for consistent scaling 
 Color selection - Customize minimum (red) and maximum (green) colors 
 
 Pro tips: 

 
 Start with auto-detect to see your data distribution 
 Switch to manual ranges for consistent thresholds across multiple Views 
 Different fields can have different color schemes 
 All standard numeric formatting (decimals, prefix/suffix) still works
